component.name: TunesBack
component.summary: Year-in-review statistics for your music library

description.p: TunesBack turns your iTunes or Apple Music library, Last.fm, ListenBrainz and Spotify history into a recap of your year in music: top songs, artists and albums, when you listen, how old your taste is, and shareable Wrapped cards.
Everything is worked out on your computer. TunesBack collects no data.
A new TunesBack: Last.fm, ListenBrainz and Spotify history, a customisable Overview, Wrapped cards, listening age and native window styles.
